Advanced Data Protection on the device vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume iCloud encryption messaging covers storefront language. iOS account security and App Store Connect actually separate system settings from product-page copy:

  • Advanced Data Protection on the device — optional toggle under Settings → Apple Account → iCloud → Advanced Data Protection. When enabled, Apple extends end-to-end encryption to most iCloud data categories. Setup requires a Recovery Contact or Recovery Key so the user can recover account access. System iCloud behavior — outside AppLocale scope.
  • Recovery Contact and Recovery Key enrollment — buyers choose trusted contacts or generate a Recovery Key before Advanced Data Protection stays on. Apple documents enrollment flows — AppLocale does not perform account recovery for buyers and does not hold recovery keys.

What Advanced Data Protection actually does — listing honesty

Apple ships Advanced Data Protection for iCloud as an optional setting that extends end-to-end encryption to most iCloud data categories beyond standard iCloud protection. Enabling it requires setting up a Recovery Contact or Recovery Key. Third-party apps may complement this by educating buyers, aligning security UX with encrypted-backup expectations, or documenting honest scope. Advanced Data Protection–specific vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

iCloud encryption marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Advanced Data Protection — not a literal paste of US marketing:

高级数据保护 vs iCloud 高级数据保护

Apple's Chinese system UI and support materials use 高级数据保护 for the Settings toggle under Apple 账户 → iCloud. Product-page copy may also use iCloud 高级数据保护 when emphasizing the iCloud scope. AppLocale picks the term buyers recognize on each screenshot — a Settings walkthrough needs Settings-aligned phrasing; a benefit headline may use iCloud 高级数据保护 when accurate to your English source.

端到端加密 (end-to-end encryption)

US pages use "End-to-end encrypted iCloud", "Most iCloud data protected", or "E2EE for iCloud backups." China storefront copy uses 端到端加密 when describing the encryption standard Advanced Data Protection extends to most iCloud categories. Do not conflate 端到端加密 with generic 跨设备同步 (sync) vocabulary unless your English source genuinely markets both.

Advanced Data Protection requires a Recovery Contact or Recovery Key before the toggle can stay enabled. zh-Hans marketing uses 恢复联系人 and 恢复密钥 on frames that explain account recovery setup — not Stolen Device Protection 安全延迟 or passcode enrollment copy unless your English source genuinely markets both.

Settings path: Apple Account → iCloud → Advanced Data Protection

Advanced Data Protection lives under Settings → Apple Account (Apple ID) → iCloud on Chinese iPhones — not under Face ID & Passcode like Stolen Device Protection, and not under Privacy & Security like Lockdown Mode. Screenshot captions that walk buyers to the toggle should use the Chinese settings path buyers see on device.
